channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lindsey Hunter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lindsey Hunter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Grant Hill on Allan Houston, Lindsey Hunter
item.description:
Hill revealed in a recent podcast interview.

“Detroit, you know, they were in a bit of transition. They drafted the year before Lindsey Hunter and Allan Houston at the point guard and shooting guard positions. So I thought I could slide right in at the pa at the small forward position and play along those guys and, kind of build with them.”

Grant Hill on Allan Houston, Lindsey Hunter, Dec 25, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Alvin Gentry, Lindsey Hunter
item.description:
Goran Dragic:

“We all loved playing for coach Alvin Gentry. He didn't fulfill the club's expectations although all of us players wanted him to stay in charge! He still ended up being fired. Lindsey Hunter became the new head coach, but he didnt have any coaching experience prior.”

Goran Dragic on Alvin Gentry, Lindsey Hunter, May 22, 2013. Source: Kosarka.si.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Lindsey Hunter
item.description:
“When he (Hunter) took over the team I think we maybe had one or two days off. I think it should be like that.”

Goran Dragic on Lindsey Hunter, Apr 17, 2013. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Lance Blanks on Lindsey Hunter
item.description:
Blanks, however, swears the two-day interview process that led to Hunter's hiring was sincere.

“At no time have I or did I talk to Lindsey about being the next coach (before Gentry was gone),”

Lance Blanks on Lindsey Hunter, Jan 25, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.
